OBJECTIVES: In this study, the evaluation of the change in pallidal index (PI) 
(ΔPI) between baseline and follow-up magnetic resonance imaging; the examination 
of the relationship between ΔPI and spot urine manganese (Mn) levels and 
baseline PI values; and the investigation of the possible effect of CaNa₂EDTA 
chelation therapy administered during the follow-up period on pallidal Mn 
accumulation were aimed.
METHODS: In 27 participants monitored due to occupational Mn exposure, right and 
left PI were measured from T1-weighted images using standard protocols. ΔPI was 
calculated as the difference between the baseline and follow-up measurements.

urinary Mn levels were assessed on the third day of treatment. In individuals
